question: Chhau is a recognised dance form, for which Shashidhar Acharya received the Padma Shri. To which part of the country does this dance form belong?
solution:
The correct answer is **Eastern.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chhau is a recognized dance form that belongs to the eastern part of India.It is primarily associated with the states of Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha.
 
• There are three main types of Chhau dance, each associated with a specific region:
 
 
• Seraikella Chhau: Originating from Jharkhand, it often depicts episodes from the Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
• Mayurbhanj Chhau: Found in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha, it also portrays stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• Purulia Chhau: Hailing from West Bengal, it incorporates elements of martial arts and is known for its vibrant masks. ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shashidhar** **Acharya**, the recipient of the Padma Shri, is associated with Chhau dance. 
 
• For other important dance forms and their states:
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**: Southern India, especially Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kathak**: Northern India, with influences from Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Kuchipudi**: Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **Odissi**: Odisha.
 
• **Manipuri**: Manipur.
